title: Names of God
definition: The names of God reveal His character, works, covenant faithfulness, authority, and relationship to His people.
summary: God's names teach His people who He is and how He acts.
christFocus: Jesus reveals the Father's name and bears divine titles that show His identity and saving work.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God's names are not empty labels. In Scripture, names reveal character, authority, covenant faithfulness, and saving action. The Lord makes Himself known through the names by which He reveals Himself.

Names such as LORD, Shepherd, Father, Redeemer, and Holy One teach believers how God relates to His people and what He has promised.

Jesus bears the name above every name, and His name reveals His mission to save His people from their sins.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People can speak about God vaguely without knowing His revealed character. The names of God matter because they teach the Church to worship the God who has made Himself known.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Study the names of God in Scripture. Let each name lead to worship, trust, prayer, and obedience.
